About Us Missy and Sean Gaffney, the visionary owners and founders of The Skin & Body Spa, are delighted to present The Medical Skin Clinic by The Skin & Body Spa, which they opened in 2019. This expansion into medical esthetics was a natural evolution of their longstanding commitment to meeting client needs for advanced services. With decades of industry expertise, Missy and Sean have cultivated a team of exceptional professionals, including highly skilled Nurse practitioners, RNs, Medical assistants, and Aestheticians. Collectively, our dedicated team members bring over 40 years of patient care experience to every treatment, ensuring unparalleled expertise in the field of skin health and beauty. Meet the Team We Offer Payment Plans Our Payment Plans are designed for your health, beauty, and wellness needs, allowing you to make convenient, monthly payments on procedures. They include fast, easy, inclusive applications that make it possible for our patients to “buy now and pay later”.
